Title: Azure Container Registry—Dedicated data endpoints now in preview

Body.Content:
Dedicated data endpoints enable you to configure your firewalls with a fully qualified domain name for the data endpoint associated with your Container Registry, as opposed to a wildcard Azure Blob storage endpoint. Lock down environments and reduce data exfiltration risks using this new feature.

Dedicated data endpoints are a feature of premium registries.

Learn more
